unverified: No auditory listening/pronunciation validation was performed.
Non-silent audio and source provenance do not independently prove spoken wording.
Frame sampling does not prove every frame or continuous motion quality.
changes: QA evidence only; no app/UI interaction, source changes, audio regeneration or video modification.
